{"id":1888155471,"question_id":4187,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months","timestamp":1768675854,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"122 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1888155471/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Best Reachable Tower","memory":"275 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    static bool mycomp(const vector<int>&t1 , const vector<int>&t2)\n    {\n        if(t1[2] != t2[2]) return t1[2] > t2[2];\n\n        if(t1[0] != t2[0]) return t1[0] < t2[0];\n        return t1[1] < t2[1];\n    }\n\n    vector<int> bestTower(vector<vector<int>>& towers, vector<int>& centre, int radius) {\n        sort(towers.begin() , towers.end() , mycomp);\n        int x = centre[0] , y = centre[1];\n\n        for(auto &t : towers)\n        {\n            int distance = abs(x - t[0]) + abs(y - t[1]);\n            if(distance <= radius) return {t[0] , t[1]};\n        }\n    return {-1 , -1};\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"best-reachable-tower","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1504}
